source: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, company tickers file (ticker to CIK)
download_command_note: SEC requires a User-Agent naming a contact; the contact used is replaced by a placeholder here.
as_of_date_basis: HTTP Last-Modified header; the file carries no date of its own
note: Public U.S. government data. CIK is the SEC registrant identifier: one per issuer, shared by its share classes. Ticker spelling uses a hyphen for share classes (BRK-B), the same as Yahoo.
